question: I maintain a CSV export pipeline for a US SaaS team. Read https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4180.html, especially "2. Definition of the CSV Format". In English, give a short operational note explaining which fields need double quotes, how a double quote inside a quoted field is escaped, and whether this memo claims to be an Internet standard. Cite inspectable passages from that exact RFC. I need source-grounded rules, not a claim that code has been executed. Keep the note within 180 words.

### Research target 1

Requested topic (unverified): “According to RFC 4180 section 2, which fields need to be enclosed in double quotes?”

Fields containing line breaks (CRLF), double quotes, and commas should be enclosed in double-quotes. [S1] Source text: “Fields containing line breaks (CRLF), double quotes, and commas        should be enclosed in double-quotes.”

### Research target 2

Requested topic (unverified): “According to RFC 4180 section 2, how is a double quote inside a quoted field escaped?”

If double-quotes are used to enclose fields, a double-quote inside a field must be escaped by preceding it with another double quote. [S1] Source text: “If double-quotes are used to enclose fields, then a double-quote        appearing inside a field must be escaped by preceding it with        another double quote.”
